title: The Mended Strap on the Satchel
youtube_title: The Mended Strap on the Satchel | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude is a useful favor, not only a thank-you word.
summary: At a cottage kitchen on an ordinary kind morning, Dahlia notices that Cousin Pio has already taken care of a satchel strap someone had stitched after quiet hours. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Dahlia does one useful thing Cousin Pio did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
